description:
The Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India aimed at promoting the marriage of persons with disabilities. 

The scheme was launched on 1st January 2013. 

It was introduced under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The primary objective of the Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana is to encourage the marriage of individuals with disabilities. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to help alleviate the economic burden associated with marriage. 

The government has set a target to support at least 10,000 marriages of persons with disabilities annually through this initiative. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at ₹50,000 per marriage. 

This amount is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

The scheme is specifically designed for individuals with disabilities as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 

Eligible beneficiaries must possess a disability certificate issued by a competent authority. 

The scheme is open to individuals with any form of disability, including physical, intellectual, and sensory disabilities. 

The age limit for male applicants is set at a minimum of 21 years. 

For female applicants, the minimum age requirement is 18 years. 

There are no specific income criteria mentioned for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, applicants must provide proof of their disability status. 

To apply for the Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana, applicants must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

Applicants must download the application form available on the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the District Social Welfare Officer. 

Along with the application form, applicants must attach a copy of their disability certificate. 

They must also provide proof of identity and address, such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

The application must be submitted before the marriage ceremony takes place. 

There is no specific deadline mentioned for applications, but it is advisable to apply well in advance. 

Once the application is submitted, the District Social Welfare Officer will verify the details. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance will be disbursed. 

The disbursement is typically made through direct bank transfer to the beneficiary's account. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. 

Contact details for the Department can be found on the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

As of 2023, thousands of marriages have been supported under this initiative. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the scheme to ensure that eligible individuals can benefit. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort to empower persons with disabilities in India. 

It aligns with the government's commitment to inclusivity and social justice. 

The initiative also aims to reduce the stigma associated with disabilities in the context of marriage. 

The financial assistance provided is intended to help families manage the costs associated with weddings. 

This includes expenses related to ceremonies, attire, and other wedding-related activities. 

The scheme has been well-received by various NGOs and disability rights organizations. 

They have advocated for greater awareness and accessibility to the benefits of the scheme. 

The government has also conducted workshops and outreach programs to educate potential beneficiaries. 

The scheme is a significant step towards ensuring that persons with disabilities have equal opportunities in society. 

It recognizes the importance of marriage as a social institution and its role in personal happiness. 

The Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana is an important part of India's social welfare framework. 

It reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the quality of life for persons with disabilities. 

The scheme is regularly reviewed to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation process. 

The government aims to ensure that the scheme reaches its intended audience effectively. 

In conclusion, the Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana is a crucial welfare initiative. 

It provides financial support to promote the marriage of persons with disabilities. 

The scheme aims to empower individuals and reduce social stigma. 

With a structured application process and clear eligibility criteria, it is designed to be accessible. 

The financial assistance of ₹50,000 per marriage is a significant support for families. 

The scheme plays a vital role in promoting inclusivity and social justice in India. 

It is an essential step towards building a more equitable society for all. 

The government continues to monitor and enhance the scheme to maximize its benefits. 

Overall, the Nihshaktajan Vivaah Protsaahan Yojana is a commendable initiative. 

It underscores the importance of supporting the rights and dignity of persons with disabilities. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to social welfare and empowerment. 

It aims to create a more inclusive environment for individuals with disabilities in India.
